profile.text: Kal'tsit, one of the founders of Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, also serves as the head of Medical. She has led many of Rhodes Island's large-scale strategic operations and overseen its external communications, making significant contributions to Rhodes Island's operations, growth, and Oripathy research. At present, she mainly participates in Rhodes Island's Oripathy medication projects as a medical expert.
